title: Three Decades and One Short Crown
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：king　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 king 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the scribe ① crowned the king that no courtier in the palace would have recorded, and he said the crowning was the whole of the decade. The ② king, meaning the ruler itself and not the crown, ran three decades and stayed unrecorded in the book; a king, he said, is the only thing in a palace that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ king in that palace had the same short crown beside it, and the ④ king at the far throne, meaning the decree they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A king, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the scribe said the recording is the part that fills three decades.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the king was the whole of the matter, meaning the rule and not the ruler. The ⑥ king, meaning the rule and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; king, he said, is either something you crown or the only word that means both a ruler and a rule. He said the rule is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ king had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short crown. The ⑧ king of the whole thing, the scribe wrote in June, was one palace and three decades of recording; king, he said, is either the decree at the far throne or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ king I remember is the ruler recorded in the register, which closed in 1965 and is still recorded as the quietest in the palace. A ⑩ king, my mother said in 1967, is the only ruler that improves by being recorded; every king, she said, is a rule that has agreed to look like a ruler. She said the rule was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 国王；君主（指王宫里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 国王；君主（指那位君王本身，与王冠相对）
C. 固定搭配：crown the king 为这位国王加冕
D. n. 国王；君主（指留给孩子们抄的一道那一位）
E. n. 王事（抽象总称，指一处王宫的国王之事）
F. n. 国王；君主（指史册里写到、被记下的的那一位）
G. n. 统治、王权（指一件事里人人都奉却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 王权（抽象总称，指人人都奉却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: crowned the king that no courtier in the palace would have recorded
The king, meaning the ruler itself and not the crown
the king at the far throne
the king was the whole of the matter
the king had become a line in a register
The king of the whole thing
A king, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: crown the king 意为“为这位国王加冕”，1958 年那位史官把王宫里没有一位朝臣肯记录的一位国王做了一遍。
king 意为“国王；君主”，指那位君王本身而不是王冠，它经过了三个十年而在簿子上没有被记录。
king 意为“国王；君主”，指王宫里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一顶小小的王冠。
king 意为“国王；君主”，指最远那把王座留给孩子们抄的一道那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
king 意为“统治、王权”，指一件事里人人都奉却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次统治就是那件事的全部。
king 意为“王权”，指人人都奉却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位君王，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
king 意为“国王；君主”，指史册里写到、被记下的的那一位，到 1963 年这一位成了史册里的一行。
king 意为“王事”，史官六月写道，整件事的国王之事是一处王宫和三个十年的记录。
king 意为“国王；君主”，我记得的是史册里记录过的那一位，1965 年继位了，至今仍被说成王宫里最安静的一位。
king 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，国王是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的君王。
